messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight report: starting changewindow deploy for service=embed-service from v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0. Running preflight checks now. SLO dashboard: https://console.redwood/inflight/shot/EMB-5143216789 :eyes:
olivia: Quick question — v3.3.0 has the new quantize-kernel packing. Any expected p95 changes on short sequences? @raj
raj: Kernel path should drop p99, might bump p50 slightly on tiny batches due to kernel startup. Ran a quick local canary on staging, looks stable. No errors observed.
kevin: Noting a small p95 blip on shadow traffic ~1m ago: baseline p95=120ms -> 134ms (+12%). No errors yet. Chart: https://dash.redwood/embeds/p95?run=5143
sre-bot: Anomaly detector: eu-west embed-route error_rate=0.6% over 2m (threshold 0.5%). Confidence=low-medium. No token-level spikes attached yet.
olivia: deploy-bot — paste the preflight summary when ready, want to decide hold vs continue.
deploy-bot: Preflight summary:
```
preflight-checks:
- shadow_requests: 200
- errors: 0
- p95_delta: +12% (baseline 120ms -> 134ms)
- kv_cache_hit: 89%
- canary_success_rate: 100% (50/50)
```
jen: The shadow set is small; +12% p95 on a tiny sample might be noise but the detector flag on eu-west is slightly worrying. Recommend hold to gather more signal.
raj: +1 to hold and expand sampling. Proposal: pause traffic shift at current step, increase shadow sampling to 1200 requests over next 10m, and pin retry route to previous stable model (v3.2.1) so retries don't hit the new path.
kevin: If we hold, set automated rollback window to 30m so ops can revert quick if errors climb. Also run quick evals against embed-regression-v2 prompt set. I can kick that off.
maria: I put a release note draft in Google: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/5143 — added a note about "quantize kernel v2" and rollback plan.
olivia: Decision: HOLD rollout. Actions: 1) pause traffic shift 2) pin retries to v3.2.1 for 2h 3) increase shadow sampling to 1200 4) run evaluation batch and surface results in 10m 5) notify CS for customers in impacted regions.
deploy-bot: Actioning: pause traffic shift -> applied. route.pin(retries)=v3.2.1 -> applied. shadow_sampler=1200 -> applied. See action log: https://deploys.redwood/actions/5143216789
sre-bot: Created incident placeholder for tracking: INC-5143216789. Tagging oncall.
kevin: Kicked off evals — batch job id eval-5143. Will post results in thread.
jen: I'll update release notes to include the hold and pin steps + expected follow-up window.
raj: I'll monitor p95/p99 and error_rate, will call rollback if error_rate>1% or p95>+30% sustained 5m.
olivia: Thanks everyone. Quick thumbs if you're on board so we can keep the hold and get more signal.
kevin: :thumbsup:
jen: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup: noted and pinged CS.
deploy-bot: preflight hold active. Next automated check in 5m.
kevin: Eval results (quick): topline embed cosine delta mean -0.002, no major regressions, attaching logs: 
```
eval-5143-sample:
- prompts: 1000
- avg_cosine: 0.873
- delta_vs_baseline: -0.002
- failures: 2/1000 (timeouts)
```
raj: Good, no quality regressions. Still watching latency signal. If p95 stabilizes within +5% on expanded sample, propose resume to next traffic step.
olivia: Sounds good. We'll reconvene on this thread at next check (in ~8m). Keep updates short.
kevin: Noted — will post if error_rate or p95 crosses thresholds.
jen: Updating release notes now with hold and rollback instructions. Link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/5143#hold-5143
mar ia: typo fix -> maria: pinged legal for FYI (customers PS-233).
deploy-bot: automated check: p95 delta on expanded sample = +4% (baseline 120ms -> 125ms), errors 5/1200 (0.42%). No rollback triggered.
olivia: OK to proceed to next step (resume to 25% traffic) if no new anomalies in next 10m. Resume window set to 10m from now.
kevin: :thumbsup: resuming schedule in 10m if clean.
raj: I'll keep an eye on eu-west. If anything spikes, I'll escalate.
jen: Release note updated with final decision.
kevin: Thanks team.
